# Tier 3, the big "does it fit" group: real programs that are built for
# size only (kind = "size-only", no run).  Generated by
# bench/programs/games_big/gen_toml.py: do not edit by hand.
#
# Upstream files are fetched at a pinned commit and checked by sha256.
# Nothing from these projects is stored in this repository.  The "edit"
# entries (every compiler gets the same text) replace the system includes
# with bench/programs/games_big/bgstub.h (and the Rogue and mojozork
# equivalents), and fix what a C23 compiler rejects.
#

# GPL-3.0-or-later; the glue files are ours.
